name: Optional FRAN-style age-conditioned skin residual
original_author: T.J.T. Roelofs / timroelofs123 independent FRAN reimplementation
license: MIT (original implementation/model as documented by author and release converter); not Disney's proprietary official FRAN model

inference.output: 1x3x512x512 RGB residual added to original RGB
inference.backend: OpenCV CPU; no torch or onnxruntime runtime dependency
inference.crop: Fixed landmark-based head crop shared with semantic parser

training_provenance: Author describes training on synthetic re-aged FFHQ faces using SAM teacher outputs. Training images are not included. Dataset rights and demographic biases are separate from code/model license.
not_copied: No FaceStudio GPL application code was copied; only its explicitly MIT-model release artifact is used with an independently authored adapter.
limitations: Optional appearance provider; mesh remains primary geometric renderer
Neural target-age conditioning is not calibrated individual age prediction
Graph baseline/masks are external controls and do not explain network internals
May hallucinate skin/identity/expression/lighting inside the proposal; semantic skin compositing required
Fast single512window gives lower detail; optional detail mode uses four512windows on768canvas. Ninewindow1024 mode is deliberately not exposed because its CPU cost consumes the20s budget.
Laptop20second end-to-end gate must be measured on the actual laptop, not inferred from cloud benchmark

validation.fixture: Public-domain NASA Eileen Collins portrait via scikit-image
validation.scope: Cloud CPU prototype observations, not a laptop performance or age-accuracy guarantee
